shared_elements: horizontal banded registers stacked one above another
repeated motifs in a rhythmic frieze
disc/circular forms (rosette centres; discs among the animals)
justification: The most specific correspondence is that each surface carries a horizontal band of repeated arch- or loop-shaped elements set directly against a plain horizontal moulding, with further registers of repeated motifs alongside — though in A that loop row is at the bottom and in B at the top, inverting the sequence. The biggest difference is subject and handling: A is a symmetrical, fine-lined vegetal repertoire (rosettes, palmettes, interlace) executed with compass-like regularity, whereas B is a coarse, schematic figural repertoire of animals in bold, irregular relief on an irregularly shaped monolith.
